Indian-origin PhD student found dead after California hike

Vikram Mubayi, an Indian-origin doctoral student at the University of California, Santa Barbara, was found dead after going missing during a solo hike in California's Big Pine Lakes area. Authorities stated there were no signs of foul play, and the investigation is continuing. Mubayi was born and raised in Hong Kong.
